lines: Day two began with a sniper.
cold
Rafael Gaita of the Hegemony waited for one head above the Concord wall.
aim
Nils Photo raised his. He was carried back badly wounded.
hit
This is Front News. Day two.
ident
The trenches kept filling. Forty-six new soldiers came up the line.
recruits
Twenty-five for the Hegemony, twenty-one for the Concord. The gap between the armies shrank to almost nothing.
recruits2
Then the storm came. Lightning showed the ground in sudden pieces.
storm
Hegemony machine guns swept the Concord parapet. Jonas Steini and Benedikt Jakubwilkuu were grazed.
mg
Three wounded. Still no dead. And two Hegemony soldiers did not answer the roll call. Bastian Hanka and Albin Chloe were missing.
missing
That day, both armies were asked one question. What does your side build?
vote
Both gave the same answer. A hospital. Seventeen to eleven for the Hegemony. Twenty-five to seven for the Concord.
vote2
And across the wire, strange things happened.
wire
A football flew over from the Concord side, with Anselm Rock's name scratched on it. Gustav Jul of the Hegemony kicked it back.
ball
Teodor Acakostic and Yann Vee traded insults for an hour. By the end, they were trading recipes.
recipes
And on a quiet night, Marek Ham and Edmund Matteozrybak called their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice.
names
Seven days later, Marek Ham was killed passing a message along the trench.
ham
The race for Verdel Ridge was now a knife edge. Concord eighty-four. Hegemony eighty-two.
race
Sixteen more soldiers, and the heights would fall. Before that night was over, they did.
race2
This was Front News. Next time: the ridge falls.
out
